verses.en: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
verses.pt: Louvai a Deus com brados de júbilo, todas as terras.
verses.en_web: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Song. A Psalm.> Send up a glad cry to God, all the earth:

verses.en: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.pt: Cantai a glória do seu nome, dai glória em seu louvor.
verses.en_web: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
verses.en_bbe: Make a song in honour of his name: give praise and glory to him.

verses.en: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
verses.pt: Dizei a Deus: Quão tremendas são as tuas obras! pela grandeza do teu poder te lisonjeiam os teus inimigos.
verses.en_web: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
verses.en_bbe: Say to God, How greatly to be feared are your works! because of your great power your haters are forced to put themselves under your feet.

verses.en: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
verses.pt: Toda a terra te adorará e te cantará louvores; eles cantarão o teu nome.
verses.en_web: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Let all the earth give you worship, and make songs to you; let them make songs to your name. (Selah.)

verses.en: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
verses.pt: Vinde, e vede as obras de Deus; ele é tremendo nos seus feitos para com os filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
verses.en_bbe: Come and see the works of God: he is to be feared in all he does to the children of men.

verses.en: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
verses.pt: Converteu o mar em terra seca; passaram o rio a pé; ali nos alegramos nele.
verses.en_web: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
verses.en_bbe: The sea was turned into dry land: they went through the river on foot: there did we have joy in him.

verses.en: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.pt: Ele governa eternamente pelo seu poder; os seus olhos estão sobre as nações; não se exaltem os rebeldes.
verses.en_web: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: He is ruling in power for ever; his eyes are watching the nations: may his haters have no strength against him. (Selah.)

verses.en: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
verses.pt: Bendizei, povos, ao nosso Deus, e fazei ouvir a voz do seu louvor;
verses.en_web: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
verses.en_bbe: Give blessings to our God, O you peoples, let the voice of his praise be loud;

verses.en: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
verses.pt: ao que nos conserva em vida, e não consente que resvalem os nossos pés.
verses.en_web: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
verses.en_bbe: Because he gives us life, and has not let our feet be moved.

verses.en: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
verses.pt: Pois tu, ó Deus, nos tens provado; tens nos refinado como se refina a prata.
verses.en_web: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
verses.en_bbe: For you, O God, have put us to the test: testing us by fire like silver.

verses.en: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
verses.pt: Fizeste-nos entrar no laço; pesada carga puseste sobre os nossos lombos.
verses.en_web: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
verses.en_bbe: You let us be put in prison; chains were put on our legs.

verses.en: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
verses.pt: Fizeste com que os homens cavalgassem sobre as nossas cabeças; passamos pelo fogo e pela água, mas nos trouxeste a um lugar de abundância.
verses.en_web: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
verses.en_bbe: You let men go driving over our heads; we went through fire and through water; but you took us out into a wide place.

verses.en: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
verses.pt: Entregarei em tua casa com holocaustos; pagar-te-ei os meus votos,
verses.en_web: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
verses.en_bbe: I will come into your house with burned offerings, I will make payment of my debt to you,

verses.en: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
verses.pt: votos que os meus lábios pronunciaram e a minha boca prometeu, quando eu estava na angústia.
verses.en_web: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
verses.en_bbe: Keeping the word which came from my lips, and which my mouth said, when I was in trouble.

verses.en: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
verses.pt: Oferecer-te-ei holocausto de animais nédios, com incenso de carneiros; prepararei novilhos com cabritos.
verses.en_web: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: I will give you burned offerings of fat beasts, and the smoke of sheep; I will make offerings of oxen and goats. (Selah.)

verses.en: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
verses.pt: Vinde, e ouvi, todos os que temeis a Deus, e eu contarei o que ele tem feito por mim.
verses.en_web: Come, and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
verses.en_bbe: Come, give ear to me, all you God-fearing men, so that I may make clear to you what he has done for my soul.

verses.en: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.pt: A ele clamei com a minha boca, e ele foi exaltado pela minha língua.
verses.en_web: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
verses.en_bbe: My voice went up to him, and I was lifted up from the underworld.

verses.en: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
verses.pt: Se eu tivesse guardado iniqüidade no meu coração, o Senhor não me teria ouvido;
verses.en_web: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
verses.en_bbe: I said in my heart, The Lord will not give ear to me:

verses.en: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.pt: mas, na verdade, Deus me ouviu; tem atendido à voz da minha oração.
verses.en_web: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
verses.en_bbe: But truly God's ear has been open; he has give attention to the voice of my prayer.

verses.en: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
verses.pt: Bendito seja Deus, que não rejeitou a minha oração, nem retirou de mim a sua benignidade.
verses.en_web: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
verses.en_bbe: Praise be to God who has not taken away his good faith and his mercy from me.
